difficulty_reason: The lemma organizes eleven exactness properties of a morphism of topoi into eight groups of implications, displayed with a picture (statement lines 9770-9814). The proof is a systematic argument: the immediate cases are noted as such (proof line 9817); the groups (b) and (c) are proved with commutative squares involving the comparison maps (proof lines 9820-9849); group (d) uses exactness of the pullback and a one-sided inverse (proof lines 9852-9863); groups (e) and (f) translate the conditions through the diagonal and codiagonal characterizations and conclude with displayed diagrams (proof lines 9865-9943); group (g) rewrites injectivity as an isomorphism and applies the previous group (proof lines 9946-9955); and group (h) is the cited categorical criterion for full faithfulness (proof lines 9958-9959). The non-formal content is the diagram bookkeeping. The claim is H2: a structured argument with every group written out.
